title: A public benchmark dataset and machine‑checkable validator suite for reproducible evaluation of LLM‑driven NetOps
research_question: Can a standardized, public dataset that couples realistic synthetic topologies, canonical intent→configuration mappings, and deterministic correctness specifications enable a paired, machine‑checkable confirmatory comparison (GVR pipeline vs single‑pass LLM) that (a) detects method differences and (b) produces reproducible binary pass/fail outcomes under fixed seeds?
confirmatory_hypotheses: H1 (confirmatory, primary): The GVR (generate–validate–repair) pipeline produces a higher per‑task validator pass rate than a frozen single‑pass LLM when evaluated on the same N=300 intent→configuration tasks (estimand: paired_success_rate_difference_guarded_minus_baseline; two‑sided α=0.05).
exploratory_questions: E1: How does inter‑run variability (fixed seeds, independent compute instances) affect per‑task binary validator outcomes (exploratory reproducibility analysis; reported but not confirmatory because no registered ICC executor is available).

E2: How do failure patterns cluster across intent categories (reachability, isolation, ACLs, route policies) and across methods (GVR, single‑pass, template) — used for qualitative/failure‑mode analysis and benchmark guidance.
E3: How well do synthetic topology diversity metrics cover features observed in selected public topology corpora (coverage/diversity report automated as part of release; exploratory comparison only).
benchmark_scope: Intent categories: reachability, isolation, ACLs, route policies
Synthetic topologies: device counts 3–50, multi‑vendor device models (abstracted), link density and path diversity ranges
Validator semantics: deterministic, snapshot (stateless) checks expressible as reachability matrices and ACL acceptance/denial expectations
Public artifacts only (synthetic generation; no customer private data)
primary_estimand: paired_success_rate_difference_guarded_minus_baseline (per‑task difference in binary validator pass rates between guarded GVR outcome and baseline single‑pass outcome; paired within task)
sampling_plan: Confirmatory paired design with N=300 unique intent→topology tasks. Tasks are divided into 4 equal intent clusters: reachability, isolation, ACLs, route policies (75 tasks per cluster). For each task a single shared initial generation is produced (used as the baseline single‑pass candidate) and the guarded GVR condition may perform up to one automatic repair call; this yields between 300 and 600 total LLM calls (maximum_model_calls=600). Each task is paired (baseline vs guarded) under the same seed. Exploratory template generator runs are optional and kept off the confirmatory set.
power_and_precision_plan: Primary estimand: paired_success_rate_difference_guarded_minus_baseline. Target effect: detect a 0.10 absolute increase in per‑task pass rate with two‑sided α=0.05. Calculation method: paired binary/outcome power approximation implemented in registered analysis code; with N=300 and conservative discordance assumptions the planned design yields ≈80% power to detect a 0.10 absolute paired difference. Sensitivity analyses recompute power for baseline p0∈{0.3,0.4,0.5,0.6}. Minimum paired completion required: 90% (≥270 completed pairs).
exclusion_rules: Items matching private-data blacklisted regexes (IP addresses, real hostnames, ASNs, emails) are excluded automatically and re‑generated with a new seed; exclusions and reasons are recorded in the execution manifest.
Items where validator returns 'ambiguous_specification' or canonicalizer fails to parse are excluded from the confirmatory set and kept in exploratory logs (recorded with hashes and reasons).
missingness_plan: Timeouts or provider/API failures preventing a model output for a paired task are handled by two pre‑registered treatments: primary (complete_pair_primary) excludes pairs where both outcomes are missing and requires ≥270 completed pairs for confirmatory inference; sensitivity (complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity) treats missing/failed model calls as validator failure (0). Retry policy: one automated retry for transient provider errors within 60s; otherwise mark as failed and proceed per failed_call_treatment. All technical failures, retries, and timestamps recorded in execution manifest.
analysis_plan: Primary confirmatory analysis will be executed by the registered executor 'paired_binary_analysis_v1' computing the estimand 'paired_success_rate_difference_guarded_minus_baseline' on the N=300 paired binary outcomes. Pre‑registered failed_call_treatments: (1) complete_pair_primary (exclude pairs with both outcomes missing; require ≥270 pairs) and (2) complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity (treat missing/failed calls as 0) for sensitivity. Report the observed paired difference, 95% confidence interval, two‑sided p‑value, and an effect‑size measure. Secondary/exploratory analyses: per‑cluster summaries, failure‑pattern clustering, and descriptive inter‑run reproducibility statistics (ICC reported descriptively). All analysis code, seeds, and manifests will be published in container images with pinned dependency versions.
multiplicity_plan: Single pre‑specified primary confirmatory hypothesis (H1). No multiplicity correction for the primary test. All other comparisons are explicitly exploratory; formal multi‑comparison adjustments (when reported) will use Holm–Bonferroni and be clearly labeled as exploratory.
contamination_plan: Governance: deterministic redaction pipeline (regex removal of IPs/hostnames/ASNs), artifact hashing (SHA‑256) and manifest generation, and automated static analysis comparing generated tokens against private‑data regexes (fail build if matched). Rules: artifacts matching blacklisted patterns are excluded and re‑generated; ambiguous validator items are excluded from confirmatory set. Analysis treatment: exclusions are removed from confirmatory N, recorded with hashes and reasons; no manual adjudication.
stopping_rule: Confirmatory run requires ≥270 completed pairs (90% of N=300). If after one automated retry policy the paired completion falls below 90% due to persistent provider/infrastructure failures or if the model‑call budget (maximum_model_calls=600) is exhausted before meeting completion, stop the confirmatory run, record failure reason and timestamps, and report results as incomplete (sensitivity analyses still presented on available data).
planned_outputs: experiment code and configuration (containerized, pinned deps)
raw experiment artifacts (generated topologies, intents, configs)
compiled PDF manuscript (≤5 pages) including Disclosure Statement
